basement.detune_piano: It can't get any worse. It tries.
basement.detune_tuned: No. It's just found its voice.
basement.heal_piano: It isn't hurt. It's out of tune, and that's a different sorrow.
basement.retune: It's already in tune. It sounds like it remembers being played.
basement.tuned1: The strings let go of their sorrow, one by one.
basement.tuned2: It sounds like a kitchen in winter. Somebody's grandmother lived in this sound.
book.empty: No drafts yet. Listen to the world: every draft is heard somewhere first.
book.help.expert: No labels. Hold Hear to listen again, and write the notes as your ear finds them.
book.help.practice: Every draft you hear is written here. Hold Hear to repeat it.
book.help.standard: Write each draft down as you hear it: tap a blank to choose its note. Hold Hear to repeat it.
cal.bluetooth: Bluetooth headphones add delay. Wired headphones or speakers work best.
cal.body: Tap the button, or press Space, on every click. This lets the Spindle place your notes where you meant them. You can skip it; nothing in the game is graded on rhythm.
cal.few: That was quiet. You can calibrate again from the menu any time.
cal.title: Tap along
caption.again_again_phone: A tinny pop hook from a phone: "Again Again (Ooh)"
caption.crack: A dry crack, and five notes falling silent
caption.crossing: A wordless choir, fading as the flock flies on
caption.encore: A real voice, a real piano, a human groove
caption.flock_brightens: Far off, for one bar, the flock's song brightens
caption.lyra_hum: A girl's hum over an old piano: the melody she wrote at fifteen
caption.park: A lonely clarinet: the swans' old theme
caption.song.again_again: "Again Again (Ooh)": four-on-the-floor, a supersaw hook, a robotic vocal
caption.song.arena: The arena PA: click track, drums, supersaw and a pre-recorded vocal
caption.song.crossing: A wordless choir drifting between two chords
caption.song.factory: Industrial four-on-the-floor at 128, everything ducking to the kick
caption.song.juno: A cheap loop pedal: drums, bass, a factory hook, and something else
caption.song.lyra: A hum over an old piano
caption.song.marcus: Buckets, played by hand, leaning back on the beat
caption.song.mirror: A dance track glued to a ticking click
caption.song.panel: A test track: sluggish drums, a robotic topline, a jingle
caption.song.park: Harp and clarinet: an old swan theme
caption.song.piano_room: An out-of-tune upright warming up in a basement
caption.song.title: A clarinet trills, then climbs
caption.song.warmup: A loud piano, a ticking metronome, a voice running scales underneath
caption.vamp: The band vamps on two chords, stalling
comb.nothing: There's no song in {target} to comb.
corridor.dancers_block: The dancers fill the corridor wall to wall. Every eight counts they step exactly where I want to be.
corridor.drift: One by one they drift off to find it. The way is clear.
corridor.frozen: The click stops. The dancers stop with it, mid-step, like toys with flat batteries.
corridor.waiting: They stand there, waiting for a beat that doesn't come.
crossing.call_landing: (a long, falling call: the landing call)
crossing.call_resting: (a softer call, rising at the end: the resting call)
crossing.echo_prompt: She wants an answer. I play her call back to her on the Distaff.
crossing.echo_rest: The resting call. Answer it, and we can land.
crossing.formation: The flock tightens behind her. The Distaff remembers: Opening.
crossing.intro1: A year of flying, or a night. Ahead of us a small blue world, humming.
crossing.intro2: The eldest calls the formations. A weaver answers with the same four notes.
crossing.landing: We fold our wings and fall towards the light.
crossing.not_that: That isn't the call she sang. She waits.
crossing.wrong: Not quite. She calls again, patient as ever.
diff.expert.help: No labels. Learn every draft by ear.
diff.practice.help: Notes are labelled and the Book writes every draft for you.
diff.standard.help: Notes are labelled as they sound. Write drafts down yourself.
dlg.choreographer.n0: Five, six, seven, eight! Again! Five, six, seven...
dlg.choreographer.n2: They stop when the kick stops. The kick never stops.
dlg.choreographer.n3: (quietly) I used to make dances up. Now I count.
dlg.coach.a1: Fitting Room. We fit voices to the song. Not the other way round.
dlg.coach.after: Thank you. I heard myself, for the first time in years.
dlg.coach.n2: Your voice is under the piano.
dlg.coach.n3: That's where they like it. Under.
dlg.coach.n4: (touching her throat) I had a scale once. Every morning. Now I sing whatever the metronome allows.
dlg.commuter.n0: Huh? What... where am I? What time is it?
dlg.commuter.n1: Morning. You were standing on the steps.
dlg.commuter.n2: I was listening. I think. To the song.
dlg.commuter.n3: Where does the song come from?
dlg.commuter.n4: The Spire. Up there. Everything comes from the Spire.
dlg.commuter.n5: (he blinks at the sky as if it's new) Huh. Birds.
dlg.dominic.a1: You're the hooded one. Juno vouched for you. Juno never vouches.
dlg.dominic.after: Doors open at nine. Go and find somewhere to stand.
dlg.dominic.n2: You built Lyra's song out of someone else's.
dlg.dominic.n3: I built it out of what works. Formula is mercy. Nobody gets hurt by a song they already know.
dlg.dominic.n4: Somebody got hurt by this one. She wrote it.
dlg.dominic.n5: (a long pause) Tonight, nine o'clock, the Mega-Dome. Every second is on the run-of-show. If she sings live and it goes wrong...
dlg.dominic.n6: You don't know what it's like when a room goes quiet.
dlg.dominic.n8: (slipping two more spools onto the Spindle) From my pedal board. You'll need the room tonight.
dlg.dominic_end.n0: (his hand hovers over the cut-feed fader. It stays there.)
dlg.dominic_end.n1: I don't own any of it, you know. Not the song. Not even the sound.
dlg.dominic_end.n2: Brickwall owns the masters. The lawyers own the notes.
dlg.dominic_show.n0: Don't. Not tonight. Not in front of all of them.
dlg.engineer.n0: Control Room B. If it's loud, it came through here.
dlg.engineer.n1: Who sings the song? The one that's everywhere?
dlg.engineer.n2: LYRIX. Well. LYRIX's voice. Well. A voice.
dlg.engineer.n3: (rubbing his eyes) I used to record bands. Whole rooms of people, breathing at the same time.
dlg.engineer.n4: Watch the desk if you like. I'm soloing the hit for the eleventh time today.
dlg.host.n0: Welcome to the Focus Group Lounge! Three listeners, three dials, one future.
dlg.host.n2: Rhythm wants it quicker. Melody wants it human. Harmony wants a little room.
dlg.host.n3: (lowering the clipboard) Between us, I'd settle for anything that isn't this.
dlg.host_pass.n0: All three green! At once! I've never... (she wipes an eye)
dlg.host_pass.n1: Here's your Preset Library pass. Don't edit anything. Nobody edits anything.
dlg.juno.a1: You're not night shift. Nobody's night shift except me.
dlg.juno.ally: Through there's the press floor. Watch your fingers. Everything ducks to the kick.
dlg.juno.n3: Everybody's following it. That's the problem.
dlg.juno.n4: (she taps her pedal) Don't tell anyone. They said my beats were too strange. Now I loop the factory hook like a good intern.
dlg.juno_gate.n0: Everything in here ducks to the kick. Even the doors. Even us.
dlg.juno_gate.n2: Dead air. The foreman comes running. Silence gets noticed in here.
dlg.juno_riff.n0: Wait. You took the hook off. That's... that's my riff under there.
dlg.juno_riff.n1: They told me it was too crooked. Too me.
dlg.juno_riff.n2: Somebody meant it. That's what matters.
dlg.juno_riff.n3: Here. Take a looper. My old one. Two spools.
dlg.juno_riff.n4: Pick a spool, arm it, play a draft: it plays it again every bar. A cast lasts one bar. A loop lasts as long as you let it.
dlg.juno_riff.n5: And you can spin any thread you comb onto a spool, and carry it. Come on. I'll get you through the factory.
dlg.juno_studio.n0: That's him. Dominic. Be nice. He thinks he's being nice too.
dlg.lyra.n0: The talent elevator, over there. Staff and talent only.
dlg.lyra.n2: Then come with me. I'll walk you in. The scanner's the hard part.
dlg.lyra_after.n0: That's mine. I wrote that at fifteen, on my grandmother's upright piano.
dlg.lyra_after.n1: They took it and rebuilt it. Now it's 'Again Again (Ooh)'. I just open my mouth on cue.
dlg.lyra_after.n2: Will you sing it? Really sing it?
dlg.lyra_after.n3: I can't sing live. My contract has a lip-sync clause. I'm literally not allowed to be heard.
dlg.lyra_after.n4: Who made your song into that?
dlg.lyra_after.n5: The Producers. The Hit Factory, under the city. Tonight they're running my show at the Mega-Dome.
dlg.lyra_after.n6: The talent elevator goes down there. Staff only. But a face is just a face, here. You could borrow one.
dlg.lyra_elevator.n0: Staff only. The scanner checks faces.
dlg.lyra_elevator.n2: Then be somebody else for a minute. You undid my mask. Can't you play it backwards?
dlg.lyra_show.n0: The dancers are locked to the click. My mic is muted by the track. And that hook isn't my song.
dlg.lyra_show.n1: If I could hear my grandmother's piano. Just once, out there.
dlg.lyra_unmasked.n1: I did. I wanted to talk to the person under it.
dlg.lyra_unmasked.n2: Nobody's asked for her in years.
dlg.lyra_unmasked.n3: (she hums four notes, very quietly, then more)
dlg.lyrix.n4: Every song is a journey! This one is three minutes and four seconds!
dlg.lyrix.n5: (to Skein) A girl made of light, answering with a poster.
dlg.marcus.n0: You liked that roll? Nobody taught me. Buckets don't come with lessons.
dlg.marcus.n2: Because the city's one song needs a second opinion.
dlg.marcus_arena.n0: Big show tonight. Not my kind of show.
dlg.marcus_arena.n1: Your groove leans back. Like a man in a good chair.
dlg.marcus_arena.n2: That's the swing. Machines can't fake it. They've tried, and it costs them a fortune.
dlg.marcus_arena.n3: Comb it, copy it, whatever you weavers do. A groove's for sharing.
dlg.receptionist.a1: Welcome to the Starlight Spire, where every star is born ready. Do you have an appointment, a look, or a lawyer?
dlg.receptionist.again: Floor forty, sweetie. The elevator knows your face now. Well. Your hood.
dlg.receptionist.n10: (quieter, just for a moment) I sang, once. In a choir. Anyway! Smile with your eyes.
dlg.receptionist.n3: Oh, we don't stock those. Have you tried a mood board?
dlg.receptionist.n4: (to Skein, quietly) On {island} the doors asked who you were. Here they ask what you've brought.
dlg.receptionist.n5: (a small, flat honk. No music in it.)
dlg.receptionist.n6: Wait. Is the swan a concept? Hooded mystic, feral-bird energy...
dlg.receptionist.n7: (into headset) Hold the talent elevator. Backup dancer, floor forty.
dlg.receptionist.n9: Nobody is, sweetie. That's what the floors are for.
draft.default.healing: {target} isn't hurt. Not in a way a draft can reach.
draft.default.healing_rev: I won't wilt {target}. Nothing here has earned that.
draft.default.hushing: {target} goes quiet for a bar. It wasn't the noise I'm after.
draft.default.hushing_rev: {target} has nothing to say, even when asked.
draft.default.opening: {target} has nothing to open. Not that it would tell me.
draft.default.opening_rev: {target} is as closed as it needs to be.
draft.default.quickening: {target} hurries for one bar and gets nowhere.
draft.default.quickening_rev: {target} slows for a bar. Nobody notices.
draft.default.tuning: {target} is in tune with itself. That's rarer than it sounds.
draft.default.tuning_rev: {target} warbles for a moment, then forgives me.
draft.default.unmasking: {target} is wearing exactly what it is.
draft.default.unmasking_rev: Masking {target} would only hide something honest.
draft.default.waking: {target} is already as awake as it gets.
draft.hushing.effect: Silences one sound or thread, for one bar.
draft.quickening.effect: Speeds up a target's tempo, for one bar.
draft.rewinding.effect: Rolls a tape, mechanism or short moment back.
draft.swelling.effect: Makes a sound louder, an object bigger.
draft.tuning.effect: Unties a pitch-correction knot; restores a voice or instrument to its natural pitch.
draft.unmasking.effect: Reveals what is under a persona, hologram or disguise.
draft.unsigning.effect: Dissolves a signature and voids what it bound.
draft.waking.effect: Snaps a zoned-out listener to attention.
elevator.already_masked: I already look like staff. That's enough for one night.
elevator.lyra_bye: Go. Find out who builds my songs. I'll be at the Mega-Dome, being mimed.
elevator.mask_scanner: The scanner doesn't need disguising. I do.
elevator.masked1: For a moment I look like anyone at all. A tired face in a lanyard.
elevator.open_doors: The doors shiver, then the scanner shuts them again. It wants a face it knows.
elevator.open_scanner: The scanner opens nothing. It only says yes or no.
elevator.scanner_ok: STAFF RECOGNISED. HAVE A PRODUCTIVE NIGHT.
elevator.scanner_says: The scanner looks at my hood and says, very politely: FACE NOT RECOGNISED.
elevator.unmask_scanner: It's just an eye. Nothing underneath but wires.
end.body: Two notes are back on the Distaff, and the flock is a little whiter. Somewhere at the top of the Chart, something has started listening. Episode 2 follows the song downstream: to the studios, the lawyers, and the Chart itself.
end.credits:
Design document by the owner. Built on placeholder art and placeholder music.
The score borrows from music now free for everyone: Gershwin, Holst and Tchaikovsky.
end.title: End of Episode 1
factory.juno_first: The intern is between me and the floor door. She hasn't decided about me yet.
factory.mute1: Watch. Tap, and one sound disappears for a bar. Tap again, it's gone again.
factory.mute2: My mute pedal. The only thing in this building that makes room.
factory.mute_before: A little pedal. She'd never let a stranger near it.
fitting.coach_hears: (to nobody) Oh. I sound like me again.
fitting.isolated: I hold her voice alone. Under the shouting piano, a small careful scale.
gate.closing: It's already closed. Now it's more closed.
gate.healing: The gate isn't hurt. It's just stubborn.
gate.locked: The gate is locked for the night. It hums one tired note.
gate.opened: The gate shivers and swings open on its own. It listened.
gate.opened2: Even here, a door can hear a draft.
gate3.bounced: I try to time it. The doors don't care about my timing; they bounce me back.
gate3.cover_first: (whispering) Cover it first. Then silence it.
gate3.foreman_clears: Somebody's looping on my kick. Not anymore. (He clears a spool and grumbles off.)
gate3.foreman_reset: Probably the wiring. It's always the wiring.
gate3.foreman_who: Who cut the kick? Nobody cuts the kick!
gate3.hush_gate: The doors aren't the sound. They're listening to it.
gate3.klaxon: DEAD AIR! DEAD AIR ON THREE!
gate3.not_long: It's open, but it won't stay open. It has to keep listening to nothing.
gate3.open: It opens, and slams, and opens, and slams. It was never closed in the way Opening understands.
gate3.open_but_alarm: It's open. But the whole floor will hear the silence any moment now.
gate3.through: The original kick is silent; the copy keeps the floor pumping. The doors swing wide and stay there. I walk through.
gate3.two_kicks: With two kicks, the gate slams twice as hard. It only listens to the original.
gate3.wedge: I'll wedge it with the FRAGILE: EMOTIONS crate. Go.
hall.braided: Brighter. But now the vocal hides it. The two are braided together.
hall.dancers_stop: The dancers stop mid-move. They hang on the kick like puppets on a string.
hall.detune_phones: The hit warbles for one bar. Everyone checks their phones, as if the phones would know.
hall.elevator_staff: STAFF AND TALENT ONLY. I'm neither, apparently.
hall.glint: A faint glint, where the pink and silver threads cross. Something's caught in the weave.
hall.heal_lyrix: Whoever's under there is tired. Healing can't reach that.
hall.miming: Silence. LYRIX keeps miming to nothing. She isn't singing at all.
hall.open_lyrix: The hologram can't open. It isn't closed; it's covering.
hall.revealed1: The silver thread splits in two: the processed topline, and a golden thread.
hall.revealed2: A slightly flat teenage voice, humming four notes. Somebody meant this once.
hall.robotic: On its own, the vocal sounds robotic. The knot pulses in time with it.
hall.tune_engine: There's no single knot in a wall of speakers. I'd need to comb it apart.
hall.unmask1: The hologram flickers and drains away like water from a glass.
hall.wake_lyrix: The light blinks. Underneath, someone is wide awake and trying not to be.
hint.A1-1.answer: Double-click the receptionist to talk to her.
hint.A1-1.nudge: Doors here don't ask who you are. Maybe she will.
hint.A1-2.answer: Double-click the mixing desk to watch the engineer solo the tracks.
hint.A1-2.nudge: The engineer takes songs apart for a living. I should watch him.
hint.A1-3.answer: Select the coach, press the comb (C), select her voice thread and hold Isolate.
hint.A1-3.look: (Skein looks at the vocal coach and tilts her head.)
hint.A1-3.nudge: Her voice is buried under the piano. I could comb them apart.
hint.A1-4.answer: Select the speakers, comb them, and pull the click track.
hint.A1-4.look: (Skein looks up at the ceiling speakers.)
hint.A1-4.nudge: The dancers move to the click. Without the click...
hint.A1-5.answer: Comb the Hook Engine. Pull the kick, bass and supersaw; then select the knotted vocal and play Tuning on it.
hint.A1-5.look: (Skein stares at the Hook Engine, head tilted, as if at a glint.)
hint.A1-5.nudge: Something is buried in the hit. Every thread I pull uncovers a little more of it.
hint.A1-6.nudge: The golden thread taught me a draft for what hides under a persona.
hint.A1-7.answer: With nothing selected, play Unmasking backwards: Masking. It disguises you.
hint.A1-7.look: (Skein looks at the face scanner, then at you.)
hint.A1-7.nudge: The scanner wants a face it knows. I could look like someone else.
hint.A2-1.answer: Select the loop pedal, comb it, and pull the factory hook and the bass.
hint.A2-1.nudge: Juno's beat sounds like everyone else's. Is any of it hers?
hint.A2-10.answer: Comb the PA. Drop the groove onto the click and the piano onto the supersaw. Then loop Hushing on the chant and on the pre-recorded vocal, and untie the last knot with Tuning.
hint.A2-10.look: (Skein looks at the arena PA, then at Lyra.)
hint.A2-10.nudge: The click holds the dancers; the track holds her microphone; the hook isn't hers.
hint.A2-2.answer: Double-click the Beat Press to listen. It teaches Quickening.
hint.A2-2.look: (Skein bobs her head at the Beat Press.)
hint.A2-2.nudge: Four strokes, over and over. That's a draft if I ever heard one.
hint.A2-3.answer: Pick a spool, arm the Spindle (the red button), then play Quickening on the conveyor. Ride it while it loops.
hint.A2-3.nudge: Quickening speeds it up for one bar. It needs to keep going.
hint.A2-4.answer: Double-click Juno's mute pedal and listen. It teaches Hushing.
hint.A2-4.nudge: Juno's other pedal makes sounds disappear.
hint.A2-5.answer: Comb the Panel. Play Tuning on the topline. Loop Quickening on the drums and Hushing on the jingle, one spool each.
hint.A2-5.look: (Skein looks from dial to dial to dial.)
hint.A2-5.nudge: Each listener hears one layer: quicker drums, a human topline, and less of that jingle.
hint.A2-6.answer: Comb the speakers. Copy the kick to one spool, then arm another and loop Hushing on the original kick. Walk through.
hint.A2-6.look: (Skein looks up at the speakers, flinching at every kick.)
hint.A2-6.nudge: The gate follows the kick. If the kick goes quiet, the floor notices, unless something else keeps pumping.
hint.A2-7.answer: Double-click Dominic to talk to him.
hint.A2-7.nudge: He runs the show. I should hear him out.
hint.A2-8.answer: Play Tuning on the piano. Then comb it and copy the piano thread to a spool.
hint.A2-8.nudge: It's her grandmother's piano, badly out of tune. Tune it first, then carry it.
hint.A2-9.answer: Comb Marcus and copy his groove to a spool.
hint.A2-9.nudge: A groove machines can't fake. The dancers could use it.
hint.P1.answer: Play the call she just sang, note for note. The Book of Patterns remembers it (B).
hint.P1.look: (The lead swan turns her head, waiting for an answer.)
hint.P1.nudge: She sang four notes. I sing the same four back.
hint.P2.answer: Click Skein to select her, then play Healing.
hint.P2.look: (Skein lies very still in the reeds.)
hint.P2.nudge: Skein is fading. Healing mends a living thing.
hint.P3.answer: Heal Skein first; the rest follows.
hint.P3.nudge: I need hands for this city.
hint.P4.answer: Select the gate and play Opening.
hint.P4.look: (Skein turns her head toward the gate.)
hint.P4.nudge: A locked gate. I know a draft for things that are closed.
hint.P5.answer: Double-click Marcus to listen to his snare roll. It teaches Waking.
hint.P5.look: (Skein looks at the drummer and sways.)
hint.P5.nudge: He's playing something nobody told him to play. I should listen.
hint.P6.answer: Select the commuter and play Waking.
hint.P6.look: (Skein looks at the man on the steps.)
hint.P6.nudge: He's asleep on his feet. Marcus's roll would snap him out of it.
hint.none: Skein tucks her head under her wing. There's nothing urgent. Just the city, humming.
juno.glint: Under the factory hook, something small and odd is trying to be heard.
juno.riff_found: Her own riff, crooked and alive, comes up through the gap.
lobby.elevator_appointment: The elevator wants an appointment. I have a question, which isn't the same.
lobby.holo_mask: A mask on a mask. It looks exactly the same.
lobby.holo_opening: Light has no door. This one is trying very hard to be a wall.
lobby.holo_unmask: It flickers, but it's only a recording. The real one must be upstairs.
look.arena_basement.boxes: Old props. A cardboard moon. A sign that says LOVE in letters taller than me.
look.arena_basement.piano: Her grandmother's piano, in tune again. It sounds like a kitchen in winter.
look.arena_basement.piano_old: An old upright. PROPERTY OF L. PLAINSONG, STORAGE. Every string is a little wrong, as if it's been crying.
look.arena_outside.marcus: Marcus has moved his buckets to where the crowds are. His groove leans back a little, like a man in a good chair.
look.arena_outside.poster: LYRIX LIVE (NOT LIVE). Someone has scratched out the second word.
look.crossing.flock: {Guild}, in feathers. They fly the way they used to weave: together, without being told.
look.crossing.lead_swan: The eldest of us leads. She sings the calls, and the flock answers.
look.crossing.nebula: Clouds of light, every colour the island never had. We've been flying through them for a year, or a night.
look.dominic_studio.console: Dominic's console. Every sound in the city could pass through here.
look.dominic_studio.dominic: Dominic Sidechain, guildmaster of the Hit Factory. He looks like a man who hasn't slept since his first hit.
look.dominic_studio.fader: The cut-feed fader. Pull it, and the whole show goes dark.
look.dominic_studio.juno: Juno, pretending to coil a cable.
look.dominic_studio.run_of_show: TONIGHT, MEGA-DOME. 9:00 LYRIX. Every second accounted for. Even the encore is on a timer.
look.factory_night.juno: The night-shift intern, building beats on a cheap pedal when she thinks no one is listening.
look.factory_night.mute_pedal: A second pedal. When she taps it, a sound goes quiet for exactly one bar.
look.factory_night.pedal: A battered loop pedal. It catches whatever she plays and plays it back, again and again.
look.factory_night.posters: WE MAKE WHAT WORKED. Under it, smaller: AND WE MAKE IT AGAIN.
look.factory_night.workbench: Cables, half-eaten noodles, a notebook full of drum patterns crossed out in red.
look.fitting_room.coach: A vocal coach running scales over a piano that's far too loud for them.
look.fitting_room.metronome: A little ticking pendulum. It never hurries and never forgives.
look.fitting_room.mirror: A mirror with lights round the edge. It flatters, then it judges.
look.fitting_room.piano: A rehearsal piano, played so hard it's almost shouting.
look.floor3.crate: A crate marked FRAGILE: EMOTIONS. Good to hide behind.
look.floor3.foreman: The foreman. He hates silence more than anything.
look.floor3.gate: Two iron doors that slam on every kick and swing open between. Too fast to walk through.
look.floor3.juno: Juno, keeping watch for the foreman.
look.floor3.shelves: The Preset Library. Drawers of sounds labelled SAD 4, HAPPY 12, ANTHEMIC (MILD).
look.floor3.sign: ALL DOORS SIDECHAINED FOR YOUR SAFETY.
look.floor3.speakers: The factory track, pumping out of the ceiling at a hundred and twenty-eight beats a minute.
look.floor40.plant: A plant made of plastic. It's doing very well.
look.floor40.poster: THIS WEEK: BE YOURSELF™. A list of approved selves underneath.
look.floor40.wardrobe: Racks of faces. Sparkle Persona, Tragic Persona, Relatable Persona. Each one on a hanger, smiling.
look.focus_lounge.dial_harmony: The harmony listener's dial. Red means too busy to hear the bass.
look.focus_lounge.dial_melody: The melody listener's dial. Red means it sounds like a machine to her.
look.focus_lounge.dial_rhythm: The rhythm listener's dial. Red means bored.
look.focus_lounge.host: The host, holding a clipboard like a shield.
look.focus_lounge.panel: The Panel: three listeners on comfortable chairs. Their dials decide every song's fate.
look.focus_lounge.screen: SEGMENT TESTED. It flashes green when the Panel approves. It has not flashed today.
look.mega_dome.booth: Dominic's booth, high over the crowd, with a view of every fader.
look.mega_dome.dancers: The dancers, locked to the click. They don't look at the crowd. They look at the beat.
look.mega_dome.dominic: Dominic, in his booth, one hand near the cut-feed fader.
look.mega_dome.lyra: Lyra under the lights. Her mouth moves. The voice comes from somewhere else.
look.mega_dome.mic: Her microphone. A little red light says MUTED.
look.mega_dome.pa: The arena PA. Every sound in the dome comes out of it, and every sound is decided upstairs.
look.mega_dome.stage: The stage, bright as noon. The crowd is already singing the song they came for.
look.mirror_corridor.dancers: Dancers, moving exactly together. Their eyes are somewhere else.
look.mirror_corridor.mirrors: A thousand of me, all in the same hood. None of them knows the way either.
look.mirror_corridor.speakers: Speakers in the ceiling, ticking like a clock that's in a hurry.
look.mixing_room.desk: A long table of sliders and lights. Each slider is a voice, or a drum, or a hum.
look.mixing_room.engineer: An engineer, bent over the desk like a weaver over a frame.
look.mixing_room.monitors: Coloured bars jump in time. Every song in the building passes through here.
look.mixing_room.window: The city, forty floors down. From up here it looks like a loom with every thread pulled tight.
look.park_gate.gate: An iron gate that opens itself. When it decides to.
look.park_gate.hedge: Clipped so square it could be a wall. Someone here is afraid of leaves.
look.park_gate.keypad: Little buttons with numbers. A door that wants a password instead of a question.
look.park_gate.sign: PARK CLOSED DUSK TO DAWN. The sky says it's dawn. The gate disagrees.
look.pond.bench: A seat for watching ducks. The ducks are not here. We are.
look.pond.flock_rest: The flock rests on the pond. Their feathers are the colour of old ash.
look.pond.jogger: A runner with a small glowing tablet. The tablet is singing at him.
look.pond.lamp: A lamp on a stick, burning without a flame. It hums one note all night.
look.pond.skein: Skein. She hatched on the crossing. She has never sung a single note.
look.pond.water: Still water. The first still thing in a long time.
look.press_floor.beat_press: The Beat Press stamps out rhythm in a four-stroke cycle. Bang, hiss, clank, ring.
look.press_floor.conveyor: The Topline Conveyor carries finished toplines up to the lounge. Slowly. A snail would pass it.
look.press_floor.hook_mill: A great wheel grinding melodies into hooks. Fine hooks, coarse hooks, hooks for every season.
look.rehearsal_hall.booth: A glass booth. Inside it, a girl made of light performs for nobody.
look.rehearsal_hall.choreographer: A choreographer counting to eight, over and over, as if it were a prayer.
look.rehearsal_hall.dancers: They hit every beat as if the beat might hit back.
look.rehearsal_hall.hook_engine: A wall of speakers. The hit pours out of it like water out of a dam.
look.rehearsal_hall.lyra: Lyra Plainsong. Under the light, a person after all.
look.rehearsal_hall.lyrix: LYRIX, in her booth. A hologram wearing a hologram. I want to talk to whoever is underneath.
look.spire_lobby.desk: A desk the shape of a smile.
look.spire_lobby.hologram: A girl made of light, singing a song that was here before she was.
look.spire_lobby.mirrors: Mirrors on every wall. Everyone in here is watching themselves, to see if they're still there.
look.spire_lobby.receptionist: She wears a headset and a smile that never moves.
look.spire_lobby.sign: WHERE EVERY STAR IS BORN READY.
look.street.billboard: LYRIX, ten storeys tall. AGAIN AGAIN (OOH). NUMBER ONE, AGAIN. The sound comes out of her mouth and every window.
look.street.commuter: He's stood on the steps with his ears plugged, staring at nothing. The song has him.
look.street.marcus: A man drumming on buckets. Nobody told him what to play. You can hear that.
look.street.speaker_pole: A tree of speakers. Every branch plays the same song.
look.talent_elevator.lyra: Lyra waits by the doors, hood up like mine. She looks happier in it than she did in the light.
look.talent_elevator.panel: Buttons for floors that don't exist. STAFF ONLY.
look.talent_elevator.scanner: An eye on the wall that checks faces. It has never had to check a hood.
loom.golden_copy: It slips through my fingers. It isn't mine to carry. Not yet.
loom.sealed: PRESET, DO NOT EDIT. I can't pull a sealed thread. Copying it, or casting on it, is another matter.
lounge.need_pass: A turnstile with a slot. PRESET LIBRARY PASS HOLDERS ONLY.
mixing.desk_again: Sliders, lights, a thousand ways to take a song apart.
mixing.flax1: When I was a boy on {island}, we combed flax before we spun it. Long strands out of a tangle.
mixing.flax2: A song can be combed apart the same way.
mixing.flax3: The Distaff grows a comb. Now I can comb a sound into its threads.
mixing.solo1: Watch this. Every song is just layers. You solo them, one at a time...
mixing.solo_supersaw: The hook. Lab-grown. Tested on focus groups.
panel.asleep: The rhythm listener nods off. Silence was not what he was missing.
panel.two_green: Two dials green. The third listener frowns.
pond.crack1: The Distaff cracks. Five notes go dark. Only c, d and e still sound.
pond.crack2: Three notes. That will have to do.
pond.grey: As it passes, the nearest swans go grey. I feel the threads pull out of them, one by one.
pond.heal_flock: They are tired, not hurt. Healing can't reach what the song is taking.
pond.jogger: (running, out of breath) ...again again, ooh, again again...
pond.jogger2: The tablet in his hand is singing. Every speaker in the city is singing the same thing.
pond.land1: A pond in a park, in a city that never stops singing.
pond.land2: We'll rest here. Just for a day.
pond.open_skein: She opens one eye, then closes it. It isn't a door she needs.
pond.skein_fading: Skein. The youngest. She was barely there to begin with, and now she's fading.
pond.skein_follow: She won't leave my side now. When I'm stuck, she sees things I don't.
pond.skein_hint_intro: (Skein bumps your hand with her head. Tap her when you're stuck.)
pond.skein_honk: (a small, flat honk. No music in it.)
pond.skein_prompt: She needs Healing. I'll stand by her and play it.
pond.skein_up: Her feathers fill in, white at the edges.
pond.swan_cant_leave: I can't walk the city in feathers. Not yet.
pond.weave1: The song will take them all if I wait here in feathers. I need hands for this city.
pond.weave2: I weave myself back into a man, thread by thread, with the last of my strength.
press.conveyor_looping: It speeds up, and stays sped up. The Spindle keeps reminding it.
press.conveyor_lurch: It lurches forward for one bar, then settles back to a crawl.
press.hush_conveyor: The conveyor goes quiet. It doesn't go faster.
press.listen1: The press stamps, hisses, clanks, rings. Four strokes, over and over.
press.listen2: Its cycle is a draft. Quickening: it makes things hurry.
press.quicken_press: The press is already going as fast as anyone has ever asked it to.
press.ride: I step on. It holds its speed bar after bar, all the way up to the lounge.
press.ride_fail: It lurches forward... and slows halfway. I step off, a little dizzy. It needs to keep going.
press.slow_conveyor: Slower than a snail is still a snail.
press.slow_press: The press slows for a bar. Somebody upstairs swears.
press.too_slow: Too slow to ride. A snail would pass it, and look back.
puzzle.A1-5: The Hit That Ate a Song
save.erase.confirm: Erase your saved game on this device?
save.import.bad: That file isn't a saved game.
save.title: Back to the title
self.default: I play to myself. It sounds better than it did yesterday.
self.healing: I'm tired, not hurt. Healing can't reach tired.
self.healing_rev: I won't do that to myself. Not today.
self.hushing: For one bar I can't even hear myself think.
self.hushing_rev: I'm already making plenty of noise.
self.opening: I open my hands. There's nothing in them but the Distaff.
self.opening_rev: Closing myself up is what the hood is for.
self.quickening: My heart hurries for a bar. The city doesn't wait anyway.
self.quickening_rev: Everything slows for a bar. It's almost restful.
self.tuning: My voice was never processed. It's out of tune all on its own.
self.tuning_rev: I warble. Skein looks embarrassed for me.
self.unmasking_rev: For a moment I look like anyone at all. Nobody here needs that from me.
self.waking_rev: Not now. Sleep is for after.
set.privacy: Nothing you do here leaves your device. There are no servers, accounts or analytics.
show.chant_added: Crowd chant, channel nine. Cover it up.
show.chant_added2: A canned crowd, whoa-oh-oh, poured over the top to hide the change.
show.chant_covered: The canned crowd falls silent, and stays silent.
show.dancers_confused: The dancers stumble. Whatever that is, it isn't a groove.
show.dancers_free: The dancers break formation and start to dance. Really dance. The crowd gasps.
show.intro1: The Mega-Dome. The band's intro vamp loops and loops. The star isn't ready, and the DJ is stalling.
show.intro2: Lyra wants to sing her own song. The PA, her microphone and her dancers all say no.
show.knot1: Auto-tune on her live channel. If she's singing, she's singing in tune.
show.knot2: A knot snaps onto her live voice. I know that knot.
show.lyra_turns: Lyra hears her grandmother's piano. She turns towards the wings, as if someone she knows has come in.
show.mic_bar: For one bar her recorded voice drops out and the mute lets go. Then it clamps down again.
show.mic_open: Her recorded voice is silent, so the tether to the mute goes slack. Her microphone light turns green.
show.need_room: (Skein looks at your spools, then at the stage. The show will need room.)
show.piano_wrong: Lyra winces. That's the piano, but not the way she remembers it.
show.res1: Lyra sings the song she wrote at fifteen, over her grandmother's piano and a street drummer's groove.
show.res3: Then one person sings along. Then thousands.
show.res4: The Distaff's g comes back, warm as a kept promise.
show.rouse_bar: Her microphone crackles to life for one bar, then the mute clamps down. I'd need a fifth spool to hold it.
show.saw_wrong: That doesn't sound like anything Lyra would turn for.
show.two_lyras: Her microphone is open, but her recorded voice still plays over her. The crowd hears two Lyras and frowns.
street.arena_closed: The Mega-Dome is shut. A sign says: TONIGHT.
street.commuter_blocks: He's standing in the middle of the steps. I don't think he knows he's there.
street.goal1: Every speaker in the city plays the same song. The swans grey every time it plays.
street.goal2: I'll follow it upstream, to wherever it's made.
street.heal_commuter: He isn't sick. He's listening too hard to something that isn't there.
street.lull_commuter: He was already halfway asleep. Now he's all the way.
street.marcus1: Outside the gate, a man drums on buckets. Not for anyone. Just because.
street.marcus2: For one bar, back at the pond, the flock was whiter. I felt it from here.
street.marcus3: Music someone means. That's what feeds the Pattern. He's living proof.
street.marcus_roll: (a snare roll on an upturned bucket, quick as rain)
studio.not_yet: Dominic hasn't finished telling me about tonight.
thread.default.any: {thread} shrugs the draft off. It isn't stuck that way.
thread.default.opening: Threads don't open. They unravel, or they don't.
thread.default.unmasking: {thread} hides nothing on its own. What it covers is another matter.
thread.default.waking: {thread} is wide awake. It never sleeps.
thread.untied: The knot loosens. {thread} sounds like a person again.
